hints.text: It is done. Line 4 stays shut, and it has your name on it now. Come and eat something.
The Foreman is in the substation at the far end of the line. He is the one holding the paper.
They are taking the platform apart down on Line 4. Get down there and stop them.
You have the form. Nothing arrives on Tuesday now. Go and find out what that did.
The Line Office is at the far end of the metro platform. Whoever signs for the money works there.
The Commuters hold Bellwater Block, one stop along. Clear it.
Somebody leaves a bag on the metro platform every Tuesday and never gets off the train. Search the lockers.
Big Starch said the money comes in on Tuesdays, from the metro side. Come and see me about it.
Starch and Sons is behind the yard. He folds every note in this city.
The laundromat is past the Rustpile Yard. Whoever pays the gangs is in there.
The Rust Rats have the yard past the alley. Go and be a nuisance.
Whoever runs Grease Alley is worth a conversation. The alley is past the market.
The Sweaters have Lantern Market boxed in. It is east along the row.
You have all four reasons. Come and tell me what they add up to.
Skip runs the Rust Rats out of the scrap office, up at the top of the heap.
Crank is in the workshop off Grease Alley. Ask her why she took it.
Auntie Vell is in the back of the wool shop, in the market.
Tally keeps the Pigeons' books in the old ticket office on the row. Start there.
Five Pigeons off the Ferry Row and I will tell you what I know.
Come and talk to me. I am by the ferry, where I always am.
